verdict.rationale: Loops documents a no-code visual editor and brand themes (colors, type, spacing) that every email picks up automatically. It also documents per-recipient dynamic variables such as {contact.firstName}, and states that Loops handles HTML generation from LMX. Reusable templates appear only indirectly (themes, and templates rebuilt in LMX), and nothing shows how emails render across email clients. Missing for 10: an explicit reusable template library, documented or tested cross-client rendering, and independent hands-on corroboration of the editor.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can design on-brand emails with a visual editor, reusable templates, and personalization tokens that render correctly across clients

citations.quote: Send transactional and marketing email from one API, one contact model, and a no-code visual editor
Set your colors, type, and spacing in one place. Every email you send picks them up automatically, so your brand stays consistent without anyone reformatting a template.
Dynamic variables like {contact.firstName} and {contact.userId} resolve per recipient at send time.
no need to generate or compile HTML inside your app. You write LMX, and Loops handles the rest.
rebuilt your templates in LMX through the Content API
